summary: Algonquin Power & Utilities Corp. filed a 6-K on November 12, 2026, announcing consent solicitations for three subordinated note series: US$350M 6.20% Series 2019-A, US$750M 4.750% Series 2022-B, and C$400M 5.250% Series 2022-A (Canadian solicitation). Proposed amendments delete the automatic-conversion-into-preferred-shares article triggered by bankruptcy/insolvency events. Consent fees: US$0.025 per US$25 (2019-A), US$1.00 per US$1,000 (2022-B), C$1.00 per C$1,000 (2022-A). Mechanics involve record dates, written consents/proxies, and extraordinary resolution for the Canadian series. Watch quorum thresholds and whether consents reach required levels; failure leaves conversion overhang intact.
